Pantera's latest State of Tokenization report is out.

Institutions entered in force this quarter. J.P. Morgan, HSBC and Fidelity launched onchain products.

BlackRock's BUIDL moved $441mn onchain in June, runs a $1bn daily redemption facility, and is now accepted as collateral.
